description: Which skill classes fire the rethinker gate that `budd hook` injects on PostToolUse (Skill) and UserPromptSubmit (/<skill>). Names are matched on the part after the last colon, so /budd:do-it matches do-it. A project may add its own skills to a class through the profile; the classes themselves are the kit's.

skip.why: Nothing to rethink: loaders, format rewrites, read-only recall, the handover, and grill-me itself (rethinking grill-me would loop).

model_skip.why: Skipped only when the model calls them as one step of another skill (PostToolUse). /code-review is the correctness engine of /budd:finalize-it Phase 1, run once per repo; the finalize hand-back is the rethinker's point. Typed by the human, the gate stays.

propose.why: Skills that write a proposal the human approves: the rethinker's points are folded into the plan before it is published, at most ONE question. The kit ships no proposal lane; a project adds its own here through the profile.

approved.why: Skills that run after the human's go-ahead: fix each point inside the approved scope, report the rest in the skill's own record, never ask. Only a point showing the solution cannot work, or would lose data or open a security hole, stops the work, as a Blocked note.

direct.why: The expectation lane: no proposal, no approval, the human typing it is the go-ahead. The rethinker reads the expectation document before the build, its points are folded in, never asked. Critical changes only: the lane's `surface` handover line decides.

learn.why: Unattended: the human reviews the lesson branch. Before it is proposed, fix each lesson a point shows is wrong or too big, drop one whose cause the rethinker could not confirm.

nested_in_direct.why: Inside a /budd:do-it run, the last `surface` line of that run decides whether these spawn the rethinker; commit-it inside the lane spawns nothing because nothing changes between the seal and the commit.

surface_marker.skip_message_commit: Rethinker skipped - nothing changed since the seal
